note: Technical validation by the coordinator; not an appearance evaluation.

actual_evaluated_character_bounds.method: World coordinates of evaluated mesh vertices, including converted curve geometry; native Curves objects contribute their authored control points.

native_curves_not_exported.reason: Native Curves (hair) objects have no faces; glTF mesh export cannot carry them. They remain in the .blend and in the Cycles renders.

procedural_material_fallbacks.reason: Unsupported procedural base-color graph; retained the material author's own swatch for GLB only.

glb_export.note: Procedural Blender shaders and lighting can differ in GLB. The source .blend was not saved or modified.
